fills.decision: on the close of the bar ending at the decision minute; entry at the open of the decision-minute bar
fills.target: a resting limit: fills at the target only if a later bar trades through it by at least 1 tick
fills.stop: a resting stop: fills at the stop, or at the bar open if the bar opens beyond it
fills.rounding: targets rounded toward the entry, stops away from it, to the tick grid
fills.flatten: at the open of the flatten-minute bar

name: Evening reversion to the 17:00 CT reopen
source: JJ Simon (6 PM ET reopen as fair price; reversion trades in the evening and Asia open)

rule.session: the Globex evening that starts the trade date: 17:00-20:30 CT on the previous calendar evening (Sunday evening for Monday)
rule.fair_price: P0 = open of the 17:00 CT bar; the day is skipped if that bar or more than 30 evening bars are missing
rule.sigma: sigma(check) = mean |close at check / P0 - 1| over the previous 14 evenings (>= 10 values)
rule.entry: flat and |price / P0 - 1| > sigma: trade toward P0 (short above, long below)
rule.stop: P0 x (1 +/- 2 x sigma) on the far side (twice the normal move)
rule.exit: target, stop, or flatten at 20:30 CT
rule.position: one at a time; at most 2 entries per evening
rule.note: evening trades belong to the next trade date (Topstep's day starts at 17:00 CT)
